pay_detail: $450. Partial and full scholarships for students with financial need.
name: Summer Textile Exploration Program (STEP)
org: NC State Wilson College of Textiles
what_you_do: Four one-week sessions where you stay on campus. You explore textiles, fashion, engineering, polymer science and marketing in college labs and studios. You also go on industry tours.
who_can_apply: Rising high school seniors. Up to 40 students per week are chosen. The choice is based on grades, activities and interest in the Wilson College of Textiles.
deadline_text: 2026 weeks: June 7-12, June 14-19, June 21-26, July 5-10. Application deadline was April 15, 2026. 2027 dates not posted yet.
